thesis: Institutions can unintentionally distribute reproductive success, but evidence does not justify genetic essentialism.

ideas.statement: Ordinary costs, norms and opportunities can select ways of life without a eugenic program.
Evidence, hypothesis and speculation must remain distinct.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Housing, migration, partner choice and family norms are mechanisms to inspect.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Heritability is not destiny; diagnosis, ideology and trait scores are different constructs.
The book rejects hierarchies of superior and inferior groups.

audit.notes: Entire assigned batch read; numbered subchapters covered; no independent citation verification.
